lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible; spacing is widest in the mid-torso region and narrows progressively toward the anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 6th vertical line from the posterior, splitting into a Y-shape at the upper dorsal margin; a secondary merging/split is visible on the 2nd line from the posterior at the mid-flank level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed segments are present between the 1st and 2nd full lines at the posterior; the 10th and 11th anterior lines terminate mid-way down the shoulder mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 4 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral haunch, situated between the posterior-most vertical line and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally, while the lower two spots align vertically above the hind limb junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white sub-orbital spot located ventral to the eye; white transverse band across the bridge of the nose; distinct white patch on the ventral-medial throat; white horizontal markings on the lower carpus and tarsus regions.
